hooks.prompt:
Verify all code in the workspace respects architectural layer boundaries. Check:
1. crates/domain/ has no imports from application, adapters, scripting, or server. No I/O crates in its Cargo.toml.
2. crates/application/ has no imports from adapters, scripting, or server. No I/O crates in its Cargo.toml.
3. crates/adapters/ has no imports from application, scripting, or server.
4. crates/scripting/ has no imports from application, adapters, or server.
5. crates/server/ can import everything (composition root).
6. Port traits are defined in domain/src/ports/, not elsewhere.
7. Authorization checks happen in application/, not in domain/ aggregates.
Report any violations found. If none, confirm the architecture is clean.
